title: koeleria cristata subsp. pyramidata
intro: Koeleria cristata subsp. pyramidata, commonly known as Pyramid Koeleria or Tufted Hair-grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria cristata subsp. pyramidata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential health benefits.
